description: The first plot in Figure 4.1 illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of the Whisper model with varying amounts of weights. The x-axis, labeled "epoch," ranges from 0 to 6, indicating the number of epochs during the training process. The y-axis, labeled "WER," ranges from 10 to 60, representing the Word Error Rate as a percentage. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different model configuration: base, small, medium, and large. The base model, shown in blue, starts with a WER of approximately 60 and decreases to around 20 by the end of the training. The small model, in orange, begins with a WER of about 50 and ends with a WER of around 30. The medium model, in green, starts with a WER of approximately 40 and concludes with a WER of about 20. Lastly, the large model, in purple, begins with a WER of around 30 and finishes with a WER of approximately 10. Each line shows a general downward trend, indicating an improvement in WER as the number of epochs increases.
